text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho got injured during training,
so I hurriedly brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Honestly, my familiar is making such a big deal over something so minor.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, but it's true you got hurt,
so that's the end of training for today.
choice_data_list: You're right, to be safe, you should rest up here...
Yeah, to be safe, let's rest here for now...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm heading to the mountains then!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What else could it be? It's obvious!
We're going to pick medicinal herbs.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I had already decided to gather ingredients for brewing a magic potion after this today.
choice_data_list: Well, if it's just moving around...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Why not?! What's wrong with picking some herbs! I've already made up my mind, so don't get in my way!"
choice_data_list: What're you gonna do if mountain climbing makes that injury worse?
What if mountain climbing makes your injury worse?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I won't mess up like that!
Anyway, I'm in a hurry, so—
choice_data_list: When I say no, I mean no.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph...!
In that case, go pick the herbs yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Gathering ingredients is something
I could just have my familiars do in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry up! A genius magical girl is busy, you know? My schedule can never be changed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I climbed the mountain as told and gathered medicinal herbs
in her stead, but Sweep Tosho remained in a foul mood
the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right, going out to pick medicinal herbs
is a piece of cake for me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be off right away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Ow!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...N-No, just kidding, it doesn't hurt at all! It'll get dark if we don't hurry, so let's get going—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ouch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...She doesn't look fine at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly stopped Sweep Tosho and made her rest.
She looked thoroughly dissatisfied the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was still worried after all,
so I decided to accompany them up the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
See? I'm totally fine!
An injury like this is nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's keep picking those herbs!
You'd better give me a hand too♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah, found it! This is it, honeysuckle!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now I can make tons of magic potions!
And the mountain climbing doubles as training—
talk about killing two birds with one stone♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, Sweep Tosho's injury didn't worsen, and the gentle mountain climb even served as a good substitute for training.
